title: WA Cares Fund Toolkit: Frequently Asked Questions (updated Oct. 20, 2026)
issuer: WA Cares Fund, Washington State Department of Social and Health Services

passages.question: Is Paid Leave and WA Cares one report or two, and how are the premiums paid?
passages.excerpt: Employers submit one report to the Employment Security Department for both Paid Leave and WA Cares but make two separate payments — one for each program — because each program has a separate trust fund.
